title.en: Check a simmer trace against its envelope: inside, left it, missed the target

goal.en: An envelope is the safe band for the medium. The check tolerates the warm-up, then requires every reading to stay in the band and, once the recipe target is reached, near it.

note.en: Warm-up to 88, then 92 and 94 degC with a target of 94 plus or minus 3: inside the band, target held.
The same pot reaches 99 degC: that is a boil, not a simmer.
Inside the band but it drifted away from the target after reaching it.
The band itself, from the vocabulary.

cli: printf '[{"t": 0, "tempC": 60}, {"t": 30, "tempC": 88}, {"t": 60, "tempC": 92}, {"t": 90, "tempC": 94}]' > trace.json && cookwala envelope cw.op.simmer trace.json --target 94 --tolerance 3
printf '[{"t": 0, "tempC": 60}, {"t": 30, "tempC": 90}, {"t": 60, "tempC": 94}, {"t": 90, "tempC": 99}]' > trace.json && cookwala envelope cw.op.simmer trace.json --target 94 --tolerance 3

outcome.en: You can tell an envelope violation from a missed target, and you know the warm-up is not a violation. Next: scenario 021 moves the boiling band with altitude.
